info.title: Orivane Atlas workspace API
info.description: HTTPS self-hosted accounts with isolated workspaces. Registration is PENDING until admin approval. Legacy-key session alone binds ADMIN to original workspace. Cookie + CSRF or 30/90/365-day or non-expiring revocable Bearer credentials: write allows create/update/delete and responses may include the affected entity (not append-only or confidential blind-write); read-write explicitly permits all private workspace content reads. Bearer forbids admin/accounts/tokens/backup/server AI. Business POSTs use atomic durable Idempotency-Key receipts and current versions. Claim/password/token issuance consume keys without replaying secret responses (409 on consumed key). Passwords and secret-response plaintext are never in receipts. Registration requires a key but deduplicates by unique normalized username (retry after success can return 400). Login/logout/read-only backup do not use receipts. No server AI configuration needed for local AI uploads. No email recovery/MFA/offline replication/public sharing or unrestricted autonomous tools. PDF is client browser print, not a PDF-generation API. Legacy /api and versioned /api/v1 aliases have identical behavior. Owner-encrypted Provider Connections, Models, Profiles and Bindings support bounded multi-provider Atlas execution. Model routing is separate from retrieval; precedence Explicit > Space > Project > Personal. Tools use real version-bound approval, shared capability services and bounded durable audit. Read old 2.0.2 encrypted provider arrays, atomically write catalog format 2 without returning keys. SQLite backup excludes the separate provider vault and its master key.

post.summary: Stateless authenticated MCP JSON-RPC
post.description: POST JSON-RPC 2.0, protocol 2025-03-26. Supports initialize, ping, notifications/initialized, tools/list and tools/call; no SSE/session transport or arbitrary tool execution. Cookie requests require CSRF and Origin checks. Personal access tokens may initialize/list/call permitted tools; workspace_snapshot requires read-write scope and exposes the authenticated workspace's work items/edges, notes, library and project materials. plan_preview stores an additive plan for human review; it does not publish or activate tasks. PATs cannot publish plans. project_document_create creates an owned Markdown document with EXTERNAL_AI provenance and deny-by-default AI policy; never a task. Mutating tools/call (plan_preview/project_document_create) require Idempotency-Key and commit with durable receipts. No key is needed for initialization, listing or snapshot reads. Tool result content is text containing serialized JSON. Unknown methods/tools return JSON-RPC errors; authorization and validation failures use HTTP error responses.

Null spaceId means workspace ownership. Requires an active session or read-write integration token.
